messages:
julia-sales: Hey team — kickoff for Lattice POC. Customer wants to evaluate qlora-13b and a quant-8 adapter variant. Need a quick catalog fit check + any enterprise blockers (KMS, SOC2, legal asks). Also need a ballpark for Dedicated vs Private. @derek-ps can you confirm kv-cache compatibility?

derek-ps: On it. kv-cache should be compatible in principle but we need to verify tokenization alignment. Which tokenizer are they using?

sara-ml: They said `fast-tokenizer-v2` in the SOW. I can run a compatibility sweep tomorrow with a small prompt set. What seq lengths should I prioritize? :mag:

kai-eng: From infra side: Dedicated can host both variants. Note quant-8 will likely degrade long-context quality — batching helps. Suggested runtime flags: `--max-batch=8 --max-seq=2048` and enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts.

derek-ps: Security check: customer requires KMS + SOC2. They prefer Private deployment but will consider Dedicated if customer-managed KMS is supported. @julia-sales can you confirm if they’ll accept Dedicated w/ CMK? :thinking_face:

julia-sales: Sales note — they said Private is preferred, but budget may push them to Dedicated. I need rough pricing numbers to steer them. Quick estimates are fine for now.

sara-ml: For quality: on our internal evals qlora-13b quant-8 shows ~2-3% drop on ROUGE-L for their summarization prompts vs fp16 baseline. I recommend regen tests and a small human check. I’ll upload results to GH after runs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kai-eng: Ops detail: qlora-13b fp16 weights ~18GB, quant-8 ~7GB (memory-mapped). On a 48GB GPU we can do 2 concurrent streams for the fp16 variant, 4+ for quant-8 depending on batch. Also check tokenizer memory for large batches.

deploy-bot: INF ticket created: INF-3241 - run compatibility sweep + KMS feasibility for Lattice POC.

derek-ps: Legal/Procurement flagged two blockers: need a data-flow diagram and a third-party license checklist (esp tokenizer/adapters). @sara-ml can you list any 3p license issues or risky deps?

sara-ml: Tokenizer is Apache-2. Adapter libs are MIT/Apache in our test stack, no GPL. Will compile a short checklist and link deps in the ticket.

julia-sales: Next steps: derek to confirm KMS flow + legal docs, kai to draft Dedicated config + rough pricing delta vs Private, sara to run compat sweep and post results. Follow-up sync tomorrow 9:00am PT. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
notes: Thread is a concise sales <> eng presales coordination about model variant onboarding, security asks, and pricing framing for a customer POC.
